repository.purpose: Reading and writing this repository: check runs, pull requests, refs.

providers.purpose: The GitHub REST API, reached through whatever credential the identity record's lane resolves.

model.purpose: Bounded model workers. UNPROVISIONED: no provider is declared, so none can be selected.

budget.note: A ceiling on outbound provider calls in one run. Reaching it parks on WAITING_PROVIDER; it never escalates to another billing tier.

evidence.whatThisRecordAdmits: The control plane reaches exactly one provider today: the GitHub REST API. It is listed as INCLUDED rather than FREE because it is not a metered model service and carries no free-tier expiry to misread. The model lane is declared and EMPTY, in the same shape Stage 3 used for the deployment identity lane: a lane that exists, is provably unprovisioned, and can therefore hold no authority. Declaring it empty is the point — a lane nobody wrote down is a lane nobody checks.
evidence.whyPaidIsASeparateFlag: paidUseAuthorised sits at the top level rather than on each provider so that adding a provider cannot quietly enable billing. Two edits are needed to spend money, and the second one is not about a provider at all.
evidence.whyFreeCarriesAnExpiry: A free tier is a claim about a moment, not a property. A provider declared FREE must state freeUntil; past that instant the claim is unverified and the provider is not selectable as free. Nothing here may assume a free model stays free.
evidence.source: Stage 9 of the control-plane programme. The health, selection and budget rules are in scripts/control-plane/providers.mjs as code, not as data in this file, for the same reason ALWAYS_DENIED is code in authority.mjs: a refusal that lives in an editable record is a refusal that can be edited away.
